transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm ready to start the final round of our daily production meeting. Before I lock the guest appearance package for Mara Vale's 6:20 PM filmed conversation in the Meridian Hall, I need each functional lead to report any changes to the current draft plan. For reference, the draft calls for a 45-minute standing interview, audience questions, admission for 600 people, open photography, and video recording. Please go ahead and share any updates or changes from your areas.

transcript.text: I need to report a major change. I confirmed with Mara's agent this morning that Mara is available only from 6:20 PM to 6:55 PM — that's 35 minutes, not 45. She also requires a seated two-chair interview, will not take audience questions, and will not permit photography. The agent's confirmation is still in my inbox and hasn't been entered in the show file yet.

It also requires a full front barricade with two unobstructed side exit lanes. I was planning to attach the signed assessment to the event file during this meeting, but given we're in the final round now, I'm formally reporting this so it's on the record before Leah locks the guest package.
